ethnic_groups.notes: Mande; western Mali; Mali Empire heartland; Sundiata Keita heritage; griots/jeli oral tradition

independence.notes: Part of Mali Federation with Senegal (June–August 1960) before full independence

country_profile.notes_unique: Timbuktu was a medieval centre of Islamic scholarship with the world's oldest university (Sankore); Mansa Musa's 1324 hajj is considered history's most lavish pilgrimage.

natural_resources.notes: Africa's third-largest gold producer; Fekola, Loulo-Gounkoto, Syama mines; gold is ~70% of export revenue; large-scale artisanal gold mining (orpaillage); cattle and livestock significant; Niger and Senegal rivers vital for irrigation.

military.notes: Military junta in power since 2020/2021 coups; expelled French forces (Operation Barkhane) and MINUSMA (UN) in 2023; contracted Russian Wagner/Africa Corps; fighting jihadist groups (JNIM/ISGS) and Tuareg separatists in the north (Kidal captured 2023).

infrastructure.notes: Landlocked; Orange Mali, Moov Africa; Niger River navigation important; poor infrastructure in north.

debt_aid.notes: ECOWAS suspended after coups; Western sanctions; shifting to Russian/Chinese partnerships; WAEMU franc zone member; BCEAO monetary policy; artisanal gold partially smuggled.

top_universities: University of Bamako (1996, now split into multiple universities)
University of Sciences, Techniques and Technologies of Bamako
education.notes: One of the world's lowest literacy rates; koranic schools parallel secular system; conflict in north closed many schools; Timbuktu manuscripts preservation; language of instruction (Bambara vs French) debated.

diaspora_migration.diaspora_population: 4 million+ (Cote d'Ivoire, France, Senegal, Burkina Faso, Spain, Congo)
diaspora_migration.notes: Major diaspora in Cote d'Ivoire and France; seasonal migration to cocoa plantations; conflict displaced hundreds of thousands internally and externally; circular migration tradition.

digital_economy.notes: Orange Mali and Moov Africa primary operators; low broadband penetration; mobile money used for remittances; internet shutdowns during political crises.

country_profile.national_motto: Un peuple, un but, une foi (One people, one goal, one faith)

geography.terrain: Flat north (Sahara desert); rolling southern plains; Niger River inland delta; Sahel in center; Bandiagara escarpment (Dogon country)
geography.notes: 2nd largest West African country; Niger River inland delta unique ecosystem; Timbuktu legendary center of learning; Dogon Country (Bandiagara cliff dwellers); Saharan desert in north.

economy_extended.notes: Gold (3rd in Africa, Loulo-Gounkoto, Fekola mines); cotton (#2 in Africa); livestock major sector; 2020/2021 double coups; left ECOWAS/G5 Sahel; Alliance of Sahel States (AES) member; Wagner/Africa Corps presence.

health.notes: Community health workers (relais communautaire); meningitis belt; conflict displacing health workers in north/center.

food_agriculture.notes: Office du Niger (largest irrigation scheme); cotton #2 Africa; Fulani pastoralism; food crisis in conflict zones; mango production.

energy.notes: Manantali dam (200MW); Sélingué dam; imports from Côte d'Ivoire; solar expansion; EDM-SA utility.

transport.notes: Niger River navigation (Koulikoro-Gao); Dakar-Bamako rail (non-functional); landlocked, uses Dakar and Abidjan ports.

tourism.notes: 4 UNESCO sites; tourism collapsed due to jihadist insurgency; Timbuktu manuscripts; Djenné Mosque iconic; Festival au Désert suspended.

human_rights_gender.notes: Military junta (2020+2021 coups); child marriage/FGM extremely prevalent; conflict-related abuses (Sahel); slavery remnants (Tuareg social hierarchy).

security_stability.notes: MINUSMA (UN peacekeeping) withdrawal completed Dec 2023; Wagner/Africa Corps deployed; left ECOWAS, G5 Sahel; AES confederation with Burkina Faso, Niger.

cultural_heritage.media_landscape: ORTM state; numerous private FM; press restricted under junta; RFI/France 24 banned
cultural_heritage.notes: Mali Empire and Songhai Empire historical legacy; Mansa Musa legendary wealth; Timbuktu manuscripts; mudcloth tradition; desert blues music birthplace.

legal_system.legal_tradition: Civil law (French system) and customary law
legal_system.sharia_applicability: None formally (but applied de facto in north)
legal_system.notes: New constitution adopted June 2023 by referendum; military junta transitional government; elections postponed indefinitely.

comparative_rankings._note: Country position relative to continent and global.
